author: KEXP
description:
Rising from the musical depths of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, Commemorate crafts ethereal soundscapes that blur the lines between dream and distortion. Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival, the band share a performance of "Away" and more. 

All 12 Live on KEXP sessions from our very first project in Asia now live on our YouTube channel. Discover the music we explored at AXEAN Festival today.
title: Commemorate performs "Away" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Commemorate performing at Puri Bhagawan. Recorded August 30, 2026.

Songs:
Dazed 00:48
Slow Down 06:40
Away 11:05
P.S. (Please Stay) 16:31
See You Again 23:34

Sasha Ningkan - Guitar, Vocals
Irman Hilmi - Guitar
Tariq Hamzah - Guitar
Wan Hafiz - Bass

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN and Jimbaran Hijab. Recorded at Puri Bhagawan, in Bali, Indonesia.
